data.long_meaning: Vikrm is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vikrama' which means 'to be strong, powerful, to be free from obstacles, to be victorious'. The name Vikrm carries the meaning “Powerful, Strong” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vikrm usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Vikramaditya I (r. 55-101 CE) was a prominent ruler of the Satavahana dynasty, based in the Deccan plateau of India. He is known for expanding his kingdom and consolidating power. His name Vikramaditya means 'sun among men'.
historical_references.context: Satavahana Dynasty, Deccan Plateau, South India

historical_references.reference: Vikramaditya VI (r. 1558-1610 CE) was a Maratha king who ruled the Kingdom of Jalna in present-day Maharashtra, India. He was a patron of arts and literature. The unit of time 'Vikram Samvat' is based on his accession year (57 CE).
